# Mandatory Requirements Assessment

**Note on counting:** Item 8 bundles five tools into one line. If each tool counts separately, there are 14 mandatory requirements and the match falls to **50% (7 of 14)**. Either way the result below is the same.

## ⚠️ Warning: Below Cutoff

The candidate's mandatory match of **70%** is below your **78% cutoff**. As you instructed, I have not evaluated the nice-to-have requirements.

**Gaps:** The candidate shows no experience with containerization or infrastructure-as-code (item 8), event streaming (Kafka), or GraphQL.
